versions.changelog:
Initial release of Complaint Cannon — escalation-aware complaint letters & case tracker.

- Generate structured, escalation-ready complaint letters from dated incident timelines.
- Integrates regulator escalation ladders, statutory rights overlays, and escalation sequencing.
- Tracks each complaint as a case with follow-up reminders, leverage routes, and full interaction history.
- Local storage; all case data saved to complaints.json.
